hypotheses.interpretation: Not supported for NGEO-009 itself under published multi-scale terrain definitions. Surrounding eastern high terrain may explain a wider visual impression, but is not silently incorporated into this island. Flat morphology is not buildable land.

hypotheses.owner_observation: 低起伏平地主要集中在西侧两个岛屿 / 岛片
